characters.summary: Cheetah is a feral combatant who relies on superhuman speed, razor-sharp claws, and enhanced physical strength. She fights in close quarters, using ambush tactics and overwhelming physical assault.
weaknesses: vulnerable to psychological manipulation regarding her humanity
limitations: animalistic bloodlust can cloud tactical thinking

sources.supports: General origin, powers, claws, speed, and status as Wonder Woman's adversary.

feats.claim: Fought evenly with Wonder Woman using her speed and claws.

notableResults.note: Defeated by Wonder Woman's superior combat skill and lasso.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses supernatural speed and agility granted by the plant god Urzkartaga.

unknowns: Exact origin variations between Barbara Ann Minerva and other iterations of Cheetah.

characters.summary: Circe is an immortal sorceress who manipulates reality, casts reality-altering curses, and transforms enemies into beasts. She prefers ranged magic and manipulation over direct physical confrontation.

sources.supports: Immortality, magical abilities, transmutation powers, and rivalry with Wonder Woman.

feats.claim: Transmuted entire groups of people into hybrid animal beasts.
feats.citation: War of the Gods comic event

notableResults.citation: War of the Gods / Wonder Woman storylines
notableResults.note: Defeated when her divine patrons withdrew support or when overpowered by combined heroes.

campaignTags.claim: Master sorceress capable of casting powerful magical spells and curses.
Uses spoken and ritualistic spells to alter reality and transform targets.
Can teleport across vast distances using magic.

unknowns: The full extent of her power limits when confronting abstract cosmic entities.

characters.summary: Clayface is a shape-shifting entity made of protoplasmic clay. He overwhelms opponents through sheer mass, suffocating attacks, and the ability to mimic any form or voice.

techniques: body weaponization into blades or maces

mechanisms: amorphous physiology that absorbs physical impacts

weaknesses: extreme vulnerability to water, extreme heat, and freezing temperatures
limitations: dissolves or loses cohesion when exposed to large quantities of water

sources.supports: Clay physiology, shape-shifting, vulnerabilities to water and temperature, and Batman rogue gallery status.

feats.claim: Reshaped his body into giant weapons to fight Batman and the Batfamily.

notableResults.note: Won initial physical encounters through ambush and overwhelming mass before being neutralized by countermeasures.

campaignTags.claim: Can expand his mass to grow into giant-sized proportions.

unknowns: Distinctions between the various individuals who took the mantle of Clayface (Basil Karlo vs. Matt Hagen).

characters.summary: James Gordon is a standard human tactician and law enforcement officer. He relies on tactical positioning, firearms, and investigative preparation rather than superhuman attributes.
weaknesses: standard human physiology with no superhuman durability

sources.supports: Role as police commissioner, tactical expertise, use of standard firearms, and human capabilities.

feats.claim: Successfully coordinated law enforcement operations against armed criminal syndicates in Gotham City.

notableResults.note: Outmatched in direct combat due to Deathstroke's physical augmentations and training.

campaignTags.claim: Can operate standard police vehicles and aircraft under normal conditions.

unknowns: Performance during his temporary tenure wearing a robotic Batman suit in DC Rebirth.

characters.summary: Cyborg is a techno-organic warrior equipped with advanced cybernetics, sonic weaponry, and Boom Tube generation technology. He fights using ranged energy blasts and tactical data processing.
weaknesses: vulnerable to advanced computer viruses and electromagnetic interference
limitations: dependent on power cells or external energy sources for prolonged heavy combat

sources.supports: Cybernetic enhancements, sonic canon, Boom Tube generation, and Justice League membership.

feats.claim: Generated a Boom Tube to transport the entire Justice League across dimensions.

notableResults.note: Overpowered by Darkseid's Omega Beams during the initial Apokoliptian invasion.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses a body fused with advanced alien and earth cybernetics.
Can generate Boom Tubes for instantaneous teleportation across space.
Integrated with Mother Box technology and advanced computer systems.
Uses internal jet propulsion systems for flight.

unknowns: Exact limits of his technopathy when interfacing with highly alien or divine machinery.

characters.summary: Darkseid is a New God tyrant who commands absolute authority and overwhelming cosmic power. He eliminates opponents with devastating Omega Beams, immense physical strength, and energy projection.
limitations: Omega Beams can occasionally be dodged or deflected under specific circumstances

sources.supports: New God physiology, Omega Beams, strength, and immortality.

feats.claim: Fired tracking Omega Beams that flawlessly pursued targets around corners.
feats.citation: Jack Kirby's Fourth World / Justice League comics

notableResults.note: Easily bypassed Cyborg's defenses with direct physical strikes and Omega Beams.

campaignTags.claim: Floats and maneuvers through the air via New God levitation.
Opens Boom Tubes for interplanetary and interdimensional travel.

unknowns: Discrepancies in power scaling between avatar appearances and his true form on Fourth World.

characters.summary: Infinite Frontier Darkseid represents a restored, multiversally integrated apex incarnation of the New God tyrant, combining absolute divine authority with reconstituted multiversal might.
weaknesses: vulnerable to concentrated multiversal crisis-level energy and specialized divine artifacts
limitations: still bound by cosmic equilibrium rules when confronting prime universal forces
characters.formDifferences: Represents a restored and amplified version of Darkseid following the events of Death Metal and Infinite Frontier, possessing heightened multiversal scale compared to standard avatars.

sources.supports: Evolution of Darkseid into the Infinite Frontier era and multiversal status.

feats.claim: Absorbed multiversal energy remnants to augment his authority across reality.

notableResults.note: Overwhelmed high-tier heroes during the realignment of the multiverse.

campaignTags.claim: Can levitate and fly through space and across realities.
Generates advanced Boom Tubes and tears through dimensional barriers.

unknowns: Full extent of his powers before complete integration with the Great Darkness.

characters.summary: Deadshot is an elite mercenary and marksman who never misses. He relies on advanced firearms mounted on his wrists and body, targeting weak points from a distance.
weaknesses: vulnerable in close-quarters melee combat against superhuman opponents
limitations: limited ammunition capacity requiring strategic reloading

sources.supports: Marksmanship, wrist guns, tactical armor, and Suicide Squad membership.

feats.claim: Hit a target by ricocheting a bullet off multiple surfaces in a single shot.

notableResults.note: Lost in a close-quarters engagement where Deathstroke's physical augmentations gave him the upper hand.

campaignTags.claim: Uses specialized wrist-mounted firearms, targeting scopes, and ballistic armor.

unknowns: Exact effectiveness against beings with absolute invulnerability.

characters.summary: Death of the Endless is the personification and inevitability of death across the universe. She does not fight in conventional battles, instead existing as an absolute cosmic constant.

mechanisms: invulnerability to all physical and magical damage

weaknesses: bound by cosmic rules governing the Endless
cannot act outside her ordained function
limitations: strictly bound to her duty and cannot engage in casual combat or personal feuds

sources.supports: Status as an Endless, embodiment of death, immortality, and cosmic function.

feats.claim: Stated she will be the last entity remaining to fold up the universe when the end arrives.

notableResults.note: Even New Gods and cosmic tyrants must eventually succumb to her when their time arrives.

campaignTags.claim: Can appear anywhere in the universe instantaneously.

unknowns: Whether her conceptual domain applies to entities outside standard multiverse physics.

characters.summary: Deathstroke is a master tactician, assassin, and enhanced supersoldier who utilizes superior physical attributes, martial arts mastery, and an array of tactical weaponry and promethium armor.
weaknesses: missing right eye creates a blind spot
limitations: dependent on physical stamina and tactical gear maintenance

sources.supports: Enhanced strength, tactical intellect, healing factor, promethium armor, and sword combat.

feats.claim: Defeated multiple members of the Justice League simultaneously using tactical preparation and martial skill.

notableResults.note: Easily bypassed Gordon's tactical positioning with superior speed and combat augmentations.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses an advanced accelerated healing factor that repairs severe tissue damage.
Carries explosives, energy staffs, swords, and specialized tactical gear.

unknowns: Variations in healing factor efficiency across different comic runs.
